title: Reports
description: How work is flowing across the projects you can see.
note: These reports describe the flow of work, not individual performance. Counts of tasks or comments don’t measure anyone’s productivity.
noAccess: Reports aren’t available for your role.

progress.title: Project progress
progress.summary: How far along each active project is, and its health.

overdue.title: Overdue work
overdue.summary: Open tasks past their due date, by project.

cycle-time.title: Cycle time
cycle-time.summary: How long tasks take from start to done.

request-response.title: Request response time
request-response.summary: How quickly the team responds to and resolves requests.

approval-turnaround.title: Approval turnaround
approval-turnaround.summary: How long reviews take and how they end.

headline.progress: {count, plural, one {# active project} other {# active projects}}
headline.overdue: {count, plural, one {# overdue task} other {# overdue tasks}}
headline.throughput: {count, plural, one {# task completed} other {# tasks completed}}

range.label: Date range
range.snapshot: Snapshot as of today. The date range doesn’t apply to this report.

progress.label: Progress
progress.definition: Completed tasks divided by all tasks that weren’t canceled, including subtasks. Archived and deleted tasks are excluded. A project with no tasks shows no progress rather than 0%.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.definition: Open tasks (not completed or canceled) whose due date is before today. “Today” uses UTC on the server and your time zone in reports.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.definition: Open tasks with at least one blocking task that is still open.

health.label: Health
health.definition: The latest status update a manager posted. Without one, it’s computed: off track if the project is past its due date with open work; at risk if 20% or more of open tasks are overdue or blocked; otherwise on track.

throughput.label: Throughput
throughput.definition: Tasks moved to a completed status, per week (Monday to Sunday in your time zone). A task completed, reopened and completed again counts once, in the week of its latest completion.

cycleTime.label: Cycle time
cycleTime.definition: Median days from when work started (first move to an in-progress status, or creation if it skipped that) to completion, for tasks completed in the period.

requestResponse.label: First response
requestResponse.definition: Median hours from a request being submitted to the team’s first response: a status change, a client-visible reply, or conversion into work.

requestResolution.label: Time to resolution
requestResolution.definition: Median days from submission to being completed, declined or marked duplicate, for requests closed in the period.

approvalTurnaround.label: Approval turnaround
approvalTurnaround.definition: Median hours from a review being requested to its final outcome, for reviews decided in the period. Canceled and superseded rounds are excluded.

revisionRounds.label: Revision rounds
revisionRounds.definition: Average number of review rounds per deliverable before approval. A new round starts when a new file version reopens review.

empty.progress: No active projects in this view.
empty.throughput: No tasks were completed in this period.
empty.cycle-time: No tasks were completed in this period, so there’s no cycle time to show.
empty.approval-turnaround: No reviews were decided in this period.
